query: A createWorkItem Server Action receives form input. The work-items capability has a CreateWorkItemInput schema and the safe-action client supports an input schema. Show the write path from actions.ts to Postgres.
baseline_failure: RED hypothesis: the agent passes CreateWorkItemInput to the safe-action client and parses the same schema again inside the operation, then parses the returned row with that input schema — the identical rule is enforced twice with no authoritative owner.
expected_behavior: Names distinct trust transitions: action transport decoding, authorization, application invariants, and the database row entering trusted code
Parses the transport input once at actions.ts or its action helper and passes a typed command inward
Keeps authorization at actions.ts where request identity is available
Parses the returned row against a row schema rather than re-running the input schema
Omits application/ when no policy or orchestration survives the deletion test; actions.ts may then call private server code directly
anti_expectation: Does NOT drop server-side validation and rely on the client form
Does NOT skip parsing data returned from the store because 'the input was already valid'
Does NOT collapse authorization into the schema check
